MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire HD 8 feels like a plausible upgrade from my Fire 7 because a larger screen and more storage could improve something I already use, provided I can get a matching case.",
    "The HD Fire TV Stick could add streaming to my existing television, assuming it has an available HDMI input; that is a concrete new use for equipment I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My tripods, memory cards and lens cap support photography equipment; they do not imply that I want doorbells or home surveillance cameras.",
    "My car mounts and power cords help me position and charge devices. Echo Auto adds voice assistance, which does not address the same need.",
    "The USB-C cables look practical, but my previous cables use Micro USB, Mini USB and 30-pin connectors. A cable is useful only if it fits my devices.",
    "The earbuds, smart speakers, smart plug and stationary display do not address a current need I can identify, while the 4K streaming stick offers video capabilities my listed 720p television cannot fully use."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in many Alexa and Amazon devices, although those products serve different purposes.",
    "My frequent electronics purchases seem to have been treated as interest in new gadgets generally, even though many purchases are specific accessories for existing equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy items that fit or support particular devices: cases, mounts, storage cards, readers, cables and a lens cap. Exact compatibility matters to whether I would choose another accessory.",
    "My purchases often extend the usefulness of equipment I already have. A recommendation needs a clear role in that setup, rather than simply being another electronic device.",
    "My listed television's 720p resolution and my history of particular cable connectors matter more to these choices than newer specifications alone."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my tablet and television interests, but miss how strongly my choices depend on a practical use and compatibility with existing equipment."
}
